newsitem.title: USA: Biomet backs Q1, FY97 estimates.
newsitem.headline: Biomet backs Q1, FY97 estimates.

text.p: Biomet Inc Chief Executive Dane Miller said Wednesday the company is comfortable with analysts' earnings estimates for the first fiscal quarter ranging from $0.20 to $0.22 a share.
Miller also backed the First Call consensus of analysts' estimates calling for fiscal 1997 earnings of $0.93 a share.
"Generally the market's expectations will be realized," Miller said in an interview following remarks to investors at a Dain Bosworth conference here.
The medical device maker completed its first quarter on August 30 and expects to report results in the next few days.
Biomet earned $0.18 a share in the first quarter of fiscal 1996. For all of fiscal 1996 it earned $0.82 a share.
